_comment: Oblast Zero English localization table. Keys used by C# chrome are declared as constants in Assets/_Project/Scripts/Core/UIStringKeys.cs — that file is the authority and tools/localization_qa.py checks this table against it. Content keys (event titleKey / narrativeTextKey / choiceLabelKey, item displayName) are authored per-object in Assets/Data/Resources and are NOT listed here. Format placeholders {0}, {1} must match one-for-one across every language table.
_voice: Post-administrative, not post-apocalyptic. Bureaucratic register. The Oblast does not raise its voice; the Oblast files a form. See CLAUDE.md 9 and design bible 7.
menu_main_file_none: NO FILE ON RECORD FOR THIS APPLICANT
menu_main_footer: OBLAST ADMINISTRATIVE DISTRICT ZERO  ·  FORM 4-B  ·  RETAIN FOR YOUR RECORDS
run_setup_subheader: COMPLETE ALL FIELDS. INCOMPLETE FORMS ARE NOT PROCESSED.
event_outcome_success: The matter resolves in your favour.
event_outcome_failure: It does not go as intended.
event_outcome_follow_up: The file remains open. Expect correspondence.
verdict_sub_all_crew_dead: NO SURVIVING PERSONNEL AT THIS ADDRESS. FILE CLOSED PENDING NEXT OF KIN.
verdict_sub_bunker_breach: SHELTER INTEGRITY LOST. THE ADDRESS IS NO LONGER LISTED.
verdict_sub_quit: APPLICANT WITHDREW BEFORE THE PERIOD CLOSED. NO ADJUSTMENT MADE.
verdict_close_all_crew_dead: "The quota for the period was met by other means."
verdict_close_bunker_breach: "Structural deviation noted. A revised floor plan has been requisitioned."
verdict_close_quit: "The form was returned incomplete. This is not, in itself, an irregularity."
verdict_close_default: "Retain this record. It will not be issued again."
options_subtitle: CHANGES TAKE EFFECT ON ENTRY. NO CONFIRMATION IS ISSUED.
options_volume_note: MASTER LEVEL ATTENUATES ALL OUTPUT. CHANNEL LEVELS ARE REGISTERED AND APPLIED PER SOURCE.
options_controls_note: SELECT A LINE ITEM TO REASSIGN IT. THE NEXT KEY PRESSED IS RECORDED.
options_language_note: THE FILE IS MAINTAINED IN BOTH LANGUAGES. NEITHER IS THE ORIGINAL.
pause_subtitle: THE EMISSION DOES NOT OBSERVE THIS PAUSE. IT IS A COURTESY OF THE INTERFACE.
first_run_setup_site: Designate a scavenge site. Each site is surveyed differently: the loot, the routes and the hazards are not the same.
first_run_setup_crew: Assign one operator. Their background and stats decide what the Oblast will let you do out there.
first_run_setup_carry: CARRY is a hard ceiling in kilograms. The site holds more than you can lift. Deciding what stays is the expedition.
first_run_scavenge_controls:
{0} MOVE   ·   MOUSE LOOK   ·   {1} SPRINT   ·   {2} TAKE   ·   {3} SUSPEND
SIXTY SECONDS. REACH THE BUNKER DOOR BEFORE THE EMISSION IS LOGGED.
first_run_bunker_end_day: END DAY advances the period. Each day your crew draws rations. Running the stores to zero is a filing error with consequences.
first_run_bunker_events: A registered deviation requires a response. There is no undo. Consequences carry to the end of the run.
ending_stabilization_body: You filed the forms. They filed you back. The bunker is now an approved demographic unit of the Scale Society. Survival is no longer optional — it is mandatory.
ending_relief_body: The 14th Regiment arrives at dawn. They do not salute. They simply lift the quarantine and tell you the Oblast is over. The cordon lifts. Somewhere behind them, the paperwork continues.
ending_adaptation_body: The Kafedra welcomes you to their specimen archive. You are not a resident of the bunker anymore. You are a data point in an ongoing study. They assure you this is a promotion.
ending_independent_body: Nobody comes. Nobody was ever going to. The stores hold, the door holds, and the correspondence stops arriving because there is no longer an office to send it. You are unaffiliated, unassisted, and on record as neither.
supply_subheader: REQUISITIONS ARE PERMANENT. NOTHING IS REFUNDED.

unlock_medkit_desc: One medical item is issued with every registration.
unlock_carry_desc: Three additional kilograms may be logged out of every site.
unlock_health_desc: Every operator on the roster is assessed ten points healthier.
unlock_sanity_desc: Every operator on the roster is assessed ten points steadier.
unlock_rep_society_desc: Registrations open with ten points of standing with the Scale Society.
unlock_rep_cordon_desc: Registrations open with ten points of standing with the Cordon.
unlock_rep_kafedra_desc: Registrations open with ten points of standing with the Kafedra.
unlock_second_site_desc: A second scavenge site is cleared for entry at registration.
unlock_second_operator_desc: A second operator may be assigned to a registration.
